title: Camera with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='12' y='32' width='76' height='50' rx='10' fill='#4a5a8a'/>
  <!-- body lighter top panel -->
  <rect x='12' y='32' width='76' height='12' rx='8' fill='#6d7fb8'/>
  <!-- viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x='36' y='22' width='28' height='14' rx='5' fill='#8a6db8'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='30' r='5' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='21' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <!-- lens inner -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='15' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <!-- lens glass shine -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='9' fill='#7fe6ff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='55' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smiling face on lens glass -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='58' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='58' r='1.8' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <path d='M45 62 Q50 66 55 62' stroke='#3a2a6a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flash light -->
  <rect x='18' y='42' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffeeaa'/>
  <!-- small side detail -->
  <rect x='72' y='50' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a9ad0'/>
</svg>
